scope: ordinary mechanism-contract sweep starting at the queued src/dsa/object.rs (live rank 178) and continuing down the production-site ranking. defects.description: ossl_bn_gen_dsa_nonce_fixed_top incremented its per-iteration digest counter (`unsigned char i` in the authority) with Rust `i += 1` on a u8. The authority wraps modulo 256; a range above roughly 130k bits would make debug builds panic (caught by guard_ffi and turned into a spurious 0) instead of continuing. Unreachable for any valid DSA/ECDSA group, but the wrap is the authority's arithmetic.
defects.fix: `i = i.wrapping_add(1)`, matching the same file's established wrapping_add use for the authority's int arithmetic.

defects.description: ossl_policy_cache_set's `# Safety` admitted a NULL `x`, but its first statement dereferences `x` and the authority dereferences unconditionally; NULL is C-invalid input, so the contract licensed UB.
defects.fix: Contract narrowed to a live, non-NULL `X509`; no code change.

defects.description: ossl_policy_cache_find_data's `# Safety` admitted a NULL `id`, but the comparator reaches `OBJ_cmp`, which reads it; NULL is C-invalid input.
defects.fix: Contract narrowed to a live, non-NULL `ASN1_OBJECT`; no code change.

defects.class: deliberate divergence not recorded as one
defects.description: DSA_set0_key releases the outgoing key with BN_clear_free where dsa_lib.c:320/324 uses BN_free. The cleansing is a safety improvement (the outgoing value is key material) and is observable only to a reader of freed memory, but the doc claimed the authority clears.
defects.fix: Doc now records the divergence and its non-observability; the cleansing release is retained.

defects.class: deliberate allocator-release divergence not recorded as one
defects.description: msg_encode's internal WPACKET-failure path clear-frees the heap block at slh_dsa.c:309, whereas the authority plain-frees that failure block at :278 (and clear-frees only the block returned to the caller, at :309/:339). Cleansing is deliberate because the block may carry part of a confidential message.
defects.fix: Doc now records the deviation explicitly; the cleansing release is retained.

residuals: DSA_set0_key keeps the cleansing BN_clear_free of outgoing key material instead of the authority's BN_free; the difference is visible only to a reader of freed memory and is recorded at the function.

msg_encode keeps a cleansing release on its internal WPACKET-failure path, where the authority plain-frees; the block may hold part of a confidential message, so the improvement is retained and recorded.

ossl_bn_gen_dsa_nonce_fixed_top skips EVP_DigestUpdate for a NULL message (the authority would pass NULL to the update); the function's contract requires a readable span, so this is a defensive guard for C-invalid input, not reachable from a conforming caller.
Line coordinates remain the crate's established 0-at-inert-mdebug convention for dsa/object, pcy_cache and bn/rand; no coordinate was changed in this batch.
